snippet.title: A Candle to the Unknown - Prologue trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Greenlight: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=930478155

A candle to the unknown is a graphic adventure of the 'Point & Click' genre with a pixelated aesthetic that it will immerse you in a story of horror, fantasy and mystery. Along the game, where you will go through a variety of sceneries, you will assume the role of Werther and other different characters embraced by a cloak of madness.

❝ And when he descends from the stars, he will open his maw and devour all sanity. Then, he will spread his nightmarish wings and cover the world with his shadow... ❞


Visit our website:  http://www.epiclords-studios.com

To download this playable prologue (Language: Spanish / English)

https://epiclords-std.itch.io/a-candle-to-the-unknown
